compile.calls_per_task: One changed guide item; repeat only to resolve a reported ambiguity.

screen.calls_per_task: One screening attempt per pair; needs_context routes directly to confirmation. Transport retries are the same logical attempt.
screen.tools: none; context is supplied in JSON

confirm.calls_per_task: Sequential calls for typed context requests and approved evidence checks, within the task budget.
confirm.session: fresh from screen; same-task context can continue
confirm.tools: read-only context and isolated approved checks

fix.calls_per_task: Sequential tool loop for one authorized finding. No child-agent spawning.
fix.session: fresh from confirmation; continue only this repair

recheck.calls_per_task: Sequential evidence requests on the frozen patched tree.
recheck.session: fresh from fixer; original finding, source, diff and actual check results

parallelism.controller: Ordinary code; model-free queueing, routing, JSON validation and accounting.
parallelism.task_unit: One rule clause paired with one code unit per review task.
parallelism.workers: Independent model calls selected by the controller. No recursive agent delegation or same-task ensembles.
parallelism.pipeline: Confirmation consumes candidates immediately while screening continues. An authorized repair can run while unrelated immutable-snapshot tasks are read.
parallelism.compiler: Run changed-rule compilation before admitting tasks for those rules.
parallelism.repair_lane_lifetime: Acquire before edits; retain through freeze, independent recheck and required validation. Start the next repair only after publication/release, or explicit abandonment under policy.
parallelism.repair_and_recheck: One repair and its recheck are sequential stages sharing the same repository repair lane.
parallelism.validation: Independent checks may overlap the fresh recheck after the source tree is frozen. Builds and platform tests obey their resource locks; the ARM64 queue remains serial.
parallelism.stale_results: Attach every result to its source and context hashes. Rebase/revalidate queued fixes before editing; invalidated results are not applied to a changed tree.
parallelism.capacity: Stage values are pilot caps, not measured service capacity. Effective admission also obeys provider request/token limits, available budget and tool resources.
parallelism.backpressure: When downstream work exceeds the configured queue budget, pause upstream admission and retain pending task IDs. Never drop coverage.
parallelism.tuning: Measure screening misses, confirmation precision, queue depth, latency, token cost and repair success before changing model, effort or concurrency. No silent model substitutions.

rationale.compile: A mistranslated rule affects every unit; spend high effort once and cache the source-backed result.
rationale.screen: Luna low is the proposed economical first pass. Favor candidate or needs_context when evidence is insufficient; audit no-signal samples.
rationale.confirm: Sol high gives the smaller candidate set deeper semantic scrutiny.
rationale.fix: Astra xhigh concentrates the strongest model and deep reasoning on confirmed work.
rationale.recheck: Sol high uses a new session and source evidence, reducing dependence on the fixer narrative. Fresh context does not guarantee independent errors.
rationale.concurrency: Eight screens demonstrate fan-out while two deeper reviews contain downstream spend. One repair lane avoids competing changes and stale validation. Read-only pool sizes remain pilot hypotheses.

invocation_metadata: The controller records requested and returned model identity, reasoning effort, configuration hash, task/schema/context identity, usage and output artifact. The model does not self-report these settings.

sources.supports: Model identifiers, supported efforts and advertised model roles.
